findings.issue: Products are distributed over sums (P9) - even the square of a mulUp result is expanded into cross terms - and the new invariant of each Newton step is not named, so the same 250-character quotient is recomputed in the convergence tests, the update and the return.
findings.rule: Do not distribute a product over a sum when the factored form is what the code computes (the factored form is shorter and exact); bind a pure expression used more than once in a block to a temporary at its first use.
